passages.text: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, “This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Moses was a prophet of God.
Aaron was Moses' brother and helper.
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
After these things happened, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh.
They spoke to Pharaoh.
They said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says this.
Let My people go.
They must hold a feast for Me in the wilderness.”
passages.original: וְאַחַ֗ר בָּ֚אוּ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וְיָחֹ֥גּוּ לִ֖י בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

passages.text: But Pharaoh replied, “Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh spoke to Moses and Aaron.
Pharaoh said, “Who is the LORD?”
Pharaoh asked, “Why should I obey His voice?”
Pharaoh said, “Why should I let Israel go?”
Pharaoh said, “I do not know the LORD.”
Pharaoh said, “I will not let Israel go.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה מִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶשְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹל֔וֹ לְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֲשַׁלֵּֽחַ׃

passages.text: “The God of the Hebrews has met with us,” they answered. “Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God, or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron spoke to Pharaoh.
They said, “The God of the Hebrews has met with us.”
They asked Pharaoh to let them go.
They said, “Let us travel three days into the wilderness.”
They said, “We want to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God.”
They warned Pharaoh.
They said, “If we do not go, the LORD may punish us.”
They said, “He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָעִבְרִ֖ים נִקְרָ֣א עָלֵ֑ינוּ נֵ֣לֲכָה נָּ֡א דֶּרֶךְ֩ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת יָמִ֜ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְנִזְבְּחָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ פֶּ֨ן־ יִפְגָּעֵ֔נוּ בַּדֶּ֖בֶר א֥וֹ בֶחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: But the king of Egypt said to them, “Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Get back to your labor!”
passages.sermon:
The king of Egypt spoke to Moses and Aaron.
He said, "Moses and Aaron, you are drawing the people away from their work."
He asked, "Why are you doing this?"
He commanded them, "Go back to your labor."
He told them to return to their own burdens.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָ֚מָּה מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן תַּפְרִ֥יעוּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם מִמַּֽעֲשָׂ֑יו לְכ֖וּ לְסִבְלֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Pharaoh also said, “Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you would be stopping them from their labor.”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh spoke to Moses and Aaron.
Pharaoh said, “There are now many people in this land.”
Pharaoh said, “You are stopping them from their work.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֔ה הֵן־ רַבִּ֥ים עַתָּ֖ה עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִשְׁבַּתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם מִסִּבְלֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: That same day Pharaoh commanded the taskmasters of the people and their foremen: “You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks. They must go and gather their own straw.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh gave an order on that same day.
He spoke to the taskmasters of the people.
He also spoke to their foremen.
Pharaoh said, “Do not give straw to the people anymore.
The people use straw to make bricks.
Before this, you gave them straw.
Now, they must go and gather straw for themselves.”
passages.original: וַיְצַ֥ו פַּרְעֹ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֶת־ הַנֹּגְשִׂ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם וְאֶת־ שֹׁטְרָ֖יו לֵאמֹֽר׃ לֹ֣א תֹאסִפ֞וּן לָתֵ֨ת תֶּ֧בֶן לָעָ֛ם לִלְבֹּ֥ן הַלְּבֵנִ֖ים כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם הֵ֚ם יֵֽלְכ֔וּ וְקֹשְׁשׁ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן׃

passages.text: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before; do not reduce it. For they are lazy; that is why they are crying out, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to our God.’
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh spoke about the Israelites.
Pharaoh said, "Give the Israelites the same number of bricks as before."
Do not lower the amount of bricks they must make.
Pharaoh said, "The Israelites are lazy."
That is why they say, 'Let us go and sacrifice to our God.'
passages.original: וְאֶת־ מַתְכֹּ֨נֶת הַלְּבֵנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ עֹשִׂ֨ים תְּמ֤וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם֙ תָּשִׂ֣ימוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־ נִרְפִּ֣ים הֵ֔ם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן הֵ֤ם צֹֽעֲקִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: Make the work harder on the men so they will be occupied and pay no attention to these lies.”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh gave an order about the Israelites.
Pharaoh said, "Make the work harder for the men."
The men must keep working.
They must stay busy with their work.
Do not let them listen to false words.
passages.original: תִּכְבַּ֧ד הָעֲבֹדָ֛ה עַל־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וְיַעֲשׂוּ־ בָ֑הּ וְאַל־ יִשְׁע֖וּ בְּדִבְרֵי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃

passages.text: So the taskmasters and foremen of the people went out and said to them, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh ruled over Egypt.
Pharaoh enslaved the Israelites.
Pharaoh appointed taskmasters and foremen over the Israelites.
The taskmasters and foremen went out to the Israelites.
They spoke to the Israelites.
They said, “Pharaoh has spoken.
Pharaoh says, ‘I will not give you straw anymore.’”
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ נֹגְשֵׂ֤י הָעָם֙ וְשֹׁ֣טְרָ֔יו וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֶל־ הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֵינֶ֛נִּי נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם תֶּֽבֶן׃

passages.text: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’ ”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh spoke to the Israelites.
Pharaoh said, "Go and get your own straw."
Find straw wherever you can.
I will not give you straw.
You must still do all your work.
I will not reduce your workload.
passages.original: אַתֶּ֗ם לְכ֨וּ קְח֤וּ לָכֶם֙ תֶּ֔בֶן מֵאֲשֶׁ֖ר תִּמְצָ֑אוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נִגְרָ֛ע מֵעֲבֹדַתְכֶ֖ם דָּבָֽר׃

passages.text: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel lived in Egypt.
Pharaoh ruled over Egypt.
Pharaoh forced the Israelites to work as slaves.
Pharaoh stopped giving straw to the Israelites.
The Israelites needed straw to make bricks.
The people scattered throughout all the land of Egypt.
They searched everywhere for stubble.
They gathered stubble to use as straw.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥פֶץ הָעָ֖ם בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ קַ֖שׁ לַתֶּֽבֶן׃

passages.text: The taskmasters kept pressing them, saying, “Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.”
passages.sermon:
The Egyptian taskmasters gave orders to the Israelites.
The taskmasters pressed the Israelites to work quickly.
They said, “Finish your work each day.
Do all your daily tasks.
Do not fall behind.
Work as you did before, when you had straw.”
passages.original: וְהַנֹּגְשִׂ֖ים אָצִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּלּ֤וּ מַעֲשֵׂיכֶם֙ דְּבַר־ י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּהְי֥וֹת הַתֶּֽבֶן׃

passages.text: Then the Israelite foremen, whom Pharaoh’s taskmasters had set over the people, were beaten and asked, “Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh’s taskmasters set Israelite foremen over the people.
The taskmasters beat the Israelite foremen.
The taskmasters asked the foremen a question.
They said, “Why did you not finish your quota of bricks?”
They said, “You did not finish your quota yesterday.”
They said, “You did not finish your quota today.”
They said, “You finished your quota before, but not now.”
passages.original: וַיֻּכּ֗וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣מוּ עֲלֵהֶ֔ם נֹגְשֵׂ֥י פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּ֡וּעַ לֹא֩ כִלִּיתֶ֨ם חָקְכֶ֤ם לִלְבֹּן֙ כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם גַּם־ תְּמ֖וֹל גַּם־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: So the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: “Why are you treating your servants this way?
passages.sermon:
The Israelite foremen were leaders among the Israelites.
Pharaoh’s taskmasters had placed these foremen over the people.
The Israelite foremen went to Pharaoh.
They cried out to Pharaoh.
They said, “Why do you treat your servants this way?”
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ שֹֽׁטְרֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר לָ֧מָּה תַעֲשֶׂ֦ה כֹ֖ה לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: No straw has been given to your servants, yet we are told, ‘Make bricks!’ Look, your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelite foremen spoke to Pharaoh.
They said, “You have not given straw to your servants.
You still command us to make bricks.
Your servants are being beaten.
The fault belongs to your own people.”
passages.original: תֶּ֗בֶן אֵ֤ין נִתָּן֙ לַעֲבָדֶ֔יךָ וּלְבֵנִ֛ים אֹמְרִ֥ים לָ֖נוּ עֲשׂ֑וּ וְהִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדֶ֛יךָ מֻכִּ֖ים וְחָטָ֥את עַמֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: “You are slackers!” Pharaoh replied. “Slackers! That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh spoke to the Israelite foremen.
Pharaoh said, “You are slackers.”
Pharaoh repeated, “You are slackers.”
Pharaoh said, “That is why you keep saying, ‘Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.’”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֛אמֶר נִרְפִּ֥ים אַתֶּ֖ם נִרְפִּ֑ים עַל־ כֵּן֙ אַתֶּ֣ם אֹֽמְרִ֔ים נֵלְכָ֖ה נִזְבְּחָ֥ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Now get to work. You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh spoke to the Israelite slaves.
He commanded them to go and work.
He told them they would not receive any straw.
He required them to produce the same number of bricks as before.
passages.original: וְעַתָּה֙ לְכ֣וּ עִבְד֔וּ וְתֶ֖בֶן לֹא־ יִנָּתֵ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם וְתֹ֥כֶן לְבֵנִ֖ים תִּתֵּֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, “You must not reduce your daily quota of bricks.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelite foremen served as leaders among the Israelites in Egypt.
Pharaoh forced the Israelites to make bricks.
Pharaoh demanded a set number of bricks each day.
Pharaoh told the foremen, “You must not reduce your daily quota of bricks.”
The foremen heard this command.
The foremen realized they were in trouble.
passages.original: וַיִּרְא֞וּ שֹֽׁטְרֵ֧י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּרָ֣ע לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־ תִגְרְע֥וּ מִלִּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם דְּבַר־ י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: When they left Pharaoh, they confronted Moses and Aaron, who stood waiting to meet them.
passages.sermon:
The Israelite foremen left Pharaoh.
Moses and Aaron stood outside.
The foremen met Moses and Aaron.
The foremen confronted them.
passages.original: וַֽיִּפְגְּעוּ֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן נִצָּבִ֖ים לִקְרָאתָ֑ם בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ת פַּרְעֹֽה׃

passages.text: “May the LORD look upon you and judge you,” the foremen said, “for you have made us a stench before Pharaoh and his officials; you have placed in their hand a sword to kill us!”
passages.sermon:
The Israelite foremen spoke to Moses and Aaron.
They said, “May the LORD see you.
May the LORD judge you.
You have made us smell bad to Pharaoh.
You have made us smell bad to his officials.
You have given them a reason to hurt us.
You have put a sword in their hand to kill us.”
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם יֵ֧רֶא יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְיִשְׁפֹּ֑ט אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִבְאַשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ רֵיחֵ֗נוּ בְּעֵינֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ וּבְעֵינֵ֣י עֲבָדָ֔יו לָֽתֶת־ חֶ֥רֶב בְּיָדָ֖ם לְהָרְגֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked, “Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?
passages.sermon:
Moses was a prophet and leader of the Israelites.
Moses went back to the LORD.
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses said, "Lord, why did You bring trouble on this people?"
Moses said, "Why did You send me?"
passages.original: וַיָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנָ֗י לָמָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֙תָה֙ לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֖ה שְׁלַחְתָּֽנִי׃

passages.text: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and You have not delivered Your people in any way.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the LORD.
Moses said he went to Pharaoh.
Moses spoke to Pharaoh in the LORD’s name.
Pharaoh brought trouble on the people of Israel.
The people of Israel suffered because of Pharaoh.
The LORD had not delivered His people.
The LORD had not saved the people of Israel in any way.
passages.original: וּמֵאָ֞ז בָּ֤אתִי אֶל־ פַּרְעֹה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ הֵרַ֖ע לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה וְהַצֵּ֥ל לֹא־ הִצַּ֖לְתָּ אֶת־ עַמֶּֽךָ׃
